content.voiceoverText: GPT-5.6 launched as Sol, Terra, and Luna. It is available across ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API. The practical shift is routing: use frontier capability for ambiguity, balanced capability for implementation, and fast checks for bounded work. Production value appears only when evidence, timing, quality gates, and approvals surround every decision.
